questions: Should the output DataFrame be sorted in any particular order (e.g., lexicographically by tuple, by first occurrence in the list, arbitrary)?
Are combinations considered unique based on the values and their positions in the list (i.e., is (a,b,c) distinct from (a,c,b) if all elements are distinct but order differs)?
If the list contains duplicate values, can the same value be used in a combination more than once if it appears at different indices?
Should the function handle floating-point numbers, or only integers?
Is the sum comparison exact (==) or within a tolerance (e.g., for floating-point numbers)?
What should happen if the input list has fewer than 3 elements?
Should the DataFrame index be reset to sequential integers starting from 0, or can it be arbitrary (e.g., based on set ordering)?
Is the element parameter guaranteed to be a number (int/float), or could it be something else (e.g., string, None)?
